Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Fig6_pathway_map.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Fig5_pPRS`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
.root <- if (exists("REPO_ROOT")) REPO_ROOT else {
  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "common", "setup.R")) && dirname(d) != d) d <- dirname(d)
  d
}
source(file.path(.root, "common", "setup.R"))
```

```{r prereq, include=FALSE}
load_prereq("Fig5_pPRS")   # loads the workspace of the previous step (or runs it first)
```

```{r paths-fig, include=FALSE}
FIG_DIR <- file.path(REPO_ROOT, "Fig6_pathway_map")
SD_DIR  <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "Source_data")
```

# Liver-to-serum pathway map: Fig. 6

Anatomical pathway figure built from Tables S1, S3, S4, S10a, S10b and S12 of the Supplementary Tables workbook.

```{r livertos-01}
## =============================================================================
##  ANATOMICAL LIVER -> SERUM PATHWAY FIGURE  (publication version)
##  Gupta et al., matched liver–serum multi-omics in severe obesity (Nat Metab)
##
##  A liver silhouette holds the hepatic pathways; a blood vessel holds the
##  serum metabolites; amino acids enter and bile acids leave across the
##  sinusoidal membrane through the transporters, drawn on the liver edge.
##
##  Encoding (identical everywhere):
##   metabolite circles: left half = steatosis, right half = lobular inflammation;
##                       fill = effect, black rim = FDR <= 0.10
##   enzymes/transporters: italic name + two tiles (steatosis | inflammation)
##   Δ next to a serum metabolite = liver–serum discordant (paired model)
##
##  All numbers are read from the Supplementary Tables, which are located by
##  their content (not by "Table S5"), so renumbering does not break anything.
##  Only the drawing (positions of nodes/arrows) is written by hand.
##  Output: PDF (vector), SVG (editable), PNG and TIFF at 600 dpi, value table.
## =============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(ggplot2)
})
XLSX    <- SUPP_XLSX
OUT_DIR <- results_dir
STEM    <- "Fig6_pathway_map"
FONT    <- "Helvetica"
PH      <- c("Steatosis", "Inflammation")
MET_FDR <- 0.10
CAP     <- 0.6                          # colour scale limit (|effect|)
TS      <- 1.15                         # text scale: 1 = original, 1.15 = 15% larger
W <- 180; H <- 195                      # mm
## =============================================================================
## 1. DATA (tables located by content)
## =============================================================================
norm_met <- function(x) gsub("^_|_$", "", gsub("[^A-Z0-9]+", "_", toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))))
catalogue <- lapply(excel_sheets(XLSX), function(s) {
  top <- suppressMessages(read_excel(XLSX, sheet = s, n_max = 8, col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal"))
  hdr <- NA_integer_
  for (r in 2:nrow(top)) { v <- unlist(top[r, ]); if (sum(!is.na(v) & nzchar(v)) >= 3) { hdr <- r; break } }
  list(sheet = s, title = as.character(top[[1]][1]), header = hdr,
       cols = if (is.na(hdr)) character(0) else as.character(unlist(top[hdr, ])))
})
find_table <- function(label, need, title_has = NULL, title_not = NULL) {
  hit <- Filter(function(s)
    all(vapply(need, function(p) any(str_detect(s$cols, regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE))), TRUE)) &&
      (is.null(title_has) || str_detect(s$title, regex(title_has, ignore_case = TRUE))) &&
      (is.null(title_not) || !str_detect(s$title, regex(title_not, ignore_case = TRUE))), catalogue)
  if (length(hit) != 1) stop(sprintf("Cannot identify the %s table (%d candidates).", label, length(hit)), call. = FALSE)
  h <- hit[[1]]; message(sprintf("  %-20s <- %s", label, h$sheet))
  d <- read_excel(XLSX, sheet = h$sheet, skip = h$header - 1, .name_repair = "minimal"); attr(d, "sheet") <- h$sheet; d
}
col_of <- function(d, p) { h <- names(d)[str_detect(names(d), regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (!length(h)) stop("No column matching '", p, "'", call. = FALSE); h[1] }
tag <- function(d) str_remove(attr(d, "sheet"), "^Table ")
message("Locating tables:")
T_gene  <- find_table("hepatic genes", c("^Ensembl gene ID$", "^log2FoldChange$", "^padj$", "^Histology$", "symbol"))
T_lip   <- find_table("hepatic lipids", c("^Lipid main ID$", "^Lipid Class$", "^(logFC|effect)"), title_not = "ST000915|external")
T_liver <- find_table("hepatic metabolites", c("^Metabolite$", "^Phenotype$", "^(logFC|effect)", "m/z"), title_not = "serum")
T_serum <- find_table("serum metabolites", c("^Metabolite$", "^Phenotype$", "^(logFC|effect)"), title_has = "serum", title_not = "paired|matched")
T_pair  <- find_table("paired liver-serum", c("^Metabolite$", "^Liver (log2FC|effect)", "^Serum (log2FC|effect)", "^Discordant"))
prs_sheet <- Filter(function(s) str_detect(s$title, regex("polygenic", ignore_case = TRUE)), catalogue)[[1]]$sheet
message(sprintf("  %-20s <- %s", "pPRS", prs_sheet))
raw <- suppressMessages(read_excel(XLSX, sheet = prs_sheet, col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal"))
h0 <- which(raw[[1]] == "outcome")[1]; end <- h0 + which(is.na(raw[[1]][(h0 + 1):nrow(raw)]))[1] - 1
hn <- as.character(unlist(raw[h0, ])); keep <- !is.na(hn) & nzchar(hn)
prs <- raw[(h0 + 1):end, keep]; names(prs) <- hn[keep]
prs <- prs |> transmute(outcome, pPRS, beta = as.numeric(`beta per SD`), se = as.numeric(SE), p = as.numeric(p)) |>
  mutate(p = ifelse(p == 0, 2 * pnorm(-abs(beta / se)), p))
gene <- T_gene |> transmute(ph = Histology, sym = .data[[col_of(T_gene, "symbol")]],
                            v = as.numeric(log2FoldChange), f = as.numeric(padj)) |>
  filter(!is.na(sym), ph %in% PH) |> group_by(ph, sym) |> slice_min(f, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup()
liver <- T_liver |> transmute(ph = Phenotype, key = norm_met(Metabolite),
  v = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_liver, "^(logFC|effect)")]]), f = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_liver, "adj\\.P\\.Val|FDR")]]))
serum <- T_serum |> transmute(ph = Phenotype, key = norm_met(Metabolite),
  v = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_serum, "^(logFC|effect)")]]), f = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_serum, "adj\\.P\\.Val|FDR")]]))
pair <- T_pair |> filter(!is.na(Metabolite), Phenotype %in% PH) |>
  transmute(ph = Phenotype, key = norm_met(Metabolite),
            L = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_pair, "^Liver (log2FC|effect)")]]), Lf = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_pair, "^Liver FDR")]]),
            S = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_pair, "^Serum (log2FC|effect)")]]), Sf = as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_pair, "^Serum FDR")]]),
            disc = as.logical(.data[[col_of(T_pair, "^Discordant")]]))
tg <- T_lip |> filter(str_detect(norm_met(`Lipid Class`), "^TG"), Phenotype %in% PH) |>
  group_by(ph = Phenotype) |>
  summarise(v = median(as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_lip, "^(logFC|effect)")]])),
            f = min(as.numeric(.data[[col_of(T_lip, "adj\\.P\\.Val|FDR")]])), .groups = "drop")
for (d in list(T_gene, T_liver, T_serum, T_lip)) if ("Direction" %in% names(d)) {
  x <- as.numeric(d[[col_of(d, "^(log2FoldChange|logFC|effect)")]])
  if (!all((x > 0) == (str_trim(d$Direction) == "Up"), na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Sign/Direction mismatch in ", attr(d, "sheet"))
}
message("  ok: effect signs agree with the Direction column")
## value of one metabolite in one compartment: paired table first (all
## estimates, n = 187), else the separate table (significant features only)
met_val <- function(key, comp) {
  if (is.na(key)) return(tibble(ph = PH, v = NA_real_, f = NA_real_, src = "none"))
  if (key == "TG") return(tg |> mutate(src = "lipid table"))
  pr <- filter(pair, key == !!key)
  if (nrow(pr)) return(pr |> transmute(ph, v = if (comp == "liver") L else S, f = if (comp == "liver") Lf else Sf,
                                       src = "paired"))
  tb <- if (comp == "liver") liver else serum
  tibble(ph = PH) |> left_join(filter(tb, key == !!key) |> select(ph, v, f), by = "ph") |>
    mutate(src = if (comp == "liver") "liver table" else "serum table")
}
## =============================================================================
## 2. DRAWING SPECIFICATION (mm; y up)
##    organ icon (top-left) -> zoom -> HEPATOCYTE (pathway cards) | sinusoidal
##    membrane (transporters) | SINUSOID / BLOOD (serum metabolites);
##    canalicular membrane (ABCB11) -> bile canaliculus at the bottom.
## =============================================================================
CELL  <- c(x0 = 2, x1 = 128, y0 = 12, y1 = 150)

X_VES <- c(137, 177)         # sinusoid

  "tyr",   "Tyr",      "TYROSINE",       112,  117,    TRUE,  "TYROSINE",
  "gln",   "Gln",      "GLUTAMINE",      112,  104,    TRUE,  "GLUTAMINE",

  "lys",   "Lys",      "LYSINE",         112,   90,    TRUE,  "LYSINE",

  "tca",   "TCA",      "TCA",            112,   46.5,  TRUE,  "TCA",
  "tdca",  "TDCA",     "TDCA",           112,   40,    TRUE,  "TDCA",

  ~lab,                       ~x,  ~y,

  "leu",           "BCKAs",                 "BCAT1",               "solid",  "above",
  "val",           "BCKAs",                 "",                    "solid",  "none",
  "BCKAs",         "Acyl-CoAs",             "BCKDHB",              "solid",  "above",
  "Acyl-CoAs",     "Succinyl-/\nacetyl-CoA", "IVD;ACADSB;ALDH6A1;MMUT", "dashed", "right",
  "phe",           "tyr",                   "",                    "dashed", "none",
  "tyr",           "Homogentisate",         "",                    "dashed", "none",
  "Homogentisate", "Fumarate,\nacetoacetate", "HGD",               "solid",  "below",
  "gln",           "glu",                   "GLS",                 "solid",  "right",
  "glu",           "2-OG",                  "GPT2",                "solid",  "below",
  "glu",           "asp",                   "GOT1",                "solid",  "below",
  "asp",           "Urea cycle",            "ASS1",                "solid",  "below",
  "NH₄⁺",          "Urea cycle",            "CPS1",                "solid",  "right",
  "trp",           "Kyn",                   "TDO2",                "solid",  "above",
  "Kyn",           "3-HK",                  "KMO",                 "solid",  "below",
  "3-HK",          "3-HAA",                 "KYNU",                "solid",  "above",
  "3-HAA",         "ACMS",                  "HAAO",                "solid",  "below_r",
  "ACMS",          "Picolinate",            "ACMSD",               "solid",  "above",
  "Kyn",           "KYNA",                  "AADAT",               "solid",  "right",
  "ACMS",          "NAD⁺",                  "",                    "dashed", "none",
  "Cholesterol",   "CA, CDCA",              "CYP7A1;CYP27A1",      "solid",  "above",
  "CA, CDCA",      "gca",                   "SLC27A5",             "solid",  "above_l",
  "CA, CDCA",      "tca",                   "",                    "solid",  "none",
  "CA, CDCA",      "tdca",                  "",                    "dashed", "none")
CARD <- tribble(
  ~title,                                       ~x0, ~x1,  ~y0,   ~y1,
  "Branched-chain and aromatic amino acids",     33, 120, 111.5, 148,
  "Glutamine, glutamate, aspartate and urea cycle", 33, 120, 84.5, 109.5,
  "Tryptophan–kynurenine",                       26, 120,  61.5,  82.5,
  "Bile acids",                                  36, 120,  25,    59.5)
## transporters: on the sinusoidal membrane (x = X_MEM) at the y of their substrate;
## ABCB11 sits on the canalicular membrane (bottom of the cell)
TRP <- tribble(~gene,   ~x,     ~y,
  "SLC3A2", X_MEM,  128,
  "SLC1A2", X_MEM,   97,
  "SLC7A2", X_MEM,   90,
  "ABCC4",  X_MEM,   49.8,
  "SLC51A", X_MEM,   40,
  "ABCB11", 104,     CELL[["y0"]])
## =============================================================================
## 3. GEOMETRY HELPERS
## =============================================================================
crspline <- function(pts, n = 30) {
  P <- rbind(pts[nrow(pts), ], pts, pts[1:2, ]); out <- NULL
  for (i in 2:(nrow(P) - 2)) {
    t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)[-n]; p0 <- P[i - 1, ]; p1 <- P[i, ]; p2 <- P[i + 1, ]; p3 <- P[i + 2, ]
    f <- function(k) 0.5 * ((2 * p1[k]) + (-p0[k] + p2[k]) * t + (2 * p0[k] - 5 * p1[k] + 4 * p2[k] - p3[k]) * t^2 +
                              (-p0[k] + 3 * p1[k] - 3 * p2[k] + p3[k]) * t^3)
    out <- rbind(out, cbind(f(1), f(2)))
  }
  tibble(x = out[, 1], y = out[, 2])
}
rrect <- function(x0, x1, y0, y1, r = 2, n = 8) {
  a <- seq(0, pi / 2, length.out = n); cx <- c(x1 - r, x0 + r, x0 + r, x1 - r); cy <- c(y1 - r, y1 - r, y0 + r, y0 + r)
  st <- c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2)
  bind_rows(lapply(1:4, \(k) tibble(x = cx[k] + r * cos(st[k] + a), y = cy[k] + r * sin(st[k] + a))))
}
half <- function(x, y, r, side, n = 30) {
  a <- if (side == "L") seq(pi / 2, 3 * pi / 2, length.out = n) else seq(-pi / 2, pi / 2, length.out = n)
  tibble(x = c(x, x + r * cos(a)), y = c(y, y + r * sin(a)))
}
circ <- function(x, y, r, n = 50) { t <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n); tibble(x = x + r * cos(t), y = y + r * sin(t)) }
ell  <- function(x, y, a, rx, ry, n = 50) { t <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n); th <- a * pi / 180
  tibble(x = x + rx * cos(t) * cos(th) - ry * sin(t) * sin(th), y = y + rx * cos(t) * sin(th) + ry * sin(t) * cos(th)) }
cw <- function(s, pt) nchar(s) * pt * TS * 0.3528 * 0.64      # text width (mm), follows TS
## organ icon: anterior liver (large right lobe on the viewer's left, left lobe
## tapering to the upper right, gallbladder at the inferior border)
org_x0 <- 4; org_y0 <- 154; sc <- 0.30
liver_icon <- crspline(rbind(
  c(4, 38), c(10, 52), c(28, 60), c(52, 61), c(76, 58), c(98, 54), c(112, 49), c(110, 44), c(92, 37),
  c(70, 28), c(58, 22), c(50, 16), c(40, 6), c(26, 4), c(13, 10), c(5, 22)), n = 22) |>
  mutate(x = org_x0 + x * sc, y = org_y0 + y * sc)
lig <- tibble(x = org_x0 + c(60, 58, 55) * sc, y = org_y0 + c(60, 40, 22) * sc)          # falciform ligament
gb_icon <- crspline(rbind(c(42, 10), c(47, 4), c(48, -3), c(43, -5), c(39, 0), c(39, 7)), n = 14) |>
  mutate(x = org_x0 + x * sc, y = org_y0 + y * sc)
zoom <- c(x0 = org_x0 + 22 * sc, x1 = org_x0 + 34 * sc, y0 = org_y0 + 28 * sc, y1 = org_y0 + 40 * sc)
## node lookup; metabolite nodes extend left by their label (label sits left of the circle)
pos <- bind_rows(
  MET |> transmute(id, x, y, wl = R + 0.9 + cw(lab, 6), wr = R + 0.4, h = 2 * R + 0.4),
  TXT |> transmute(id = lab, x, y, wl = vapply(str_split(lab, "\n"), \(z) max(cw(z, 6)), 0) / 2 + 0.6,
                   wr = vapply(str_split(lab, "\n"), \(z) max(cw(z, 6)), 0) / 2 + 0.6, h = 2.6 * (str_count(lab, "\n") + 1)))
arrows <- ARR |>
  left_join(rename_with(pos, ~ paste0(.x, "0"), -id), by = c(from = "id")) |>
  left_join(rename_with(pos, ~ paste0(.x, "1"), -id), by = c(to = "id")) |>
  mutate(dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, d = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2),
         s0 = abs(dx) / d * ifelse(dx < 0, wl0, wr0) + abs(dy) / d * (h0 / 2 + 0.5) + 0.5,
         s1 = abs(dx) / d * ifelse(dx < 0, wr1, wl1) + abs(dy) / d * (h1 / 2 + 0.5) + 0.5,
         xs = x0 + dx / d * s0, ys = y0 + dy / d * s0, xe = x1 - dx / d * s1, ye = y1 - dy / d * s1,
         mx = (xs + xe) / 2, my = (ys + ye) / 2)
stopifnot(!anyNA(arrows$x0), !anyNA(arrows$x1))
TW <- 2.9 * sqrt(TS); TH <- 2.3 * sqrt(TS); EPT <- 5.2
enz <- arrows |> filter(nzchar(enz)) |> mutate(k = row_number()) |>
  separate_rows(enz, sep = ";") |> group_by(k) |> mutate(j = row_number(), nj = n()) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(gw = cw(enz, EPT) + 0.8 + 2 * TW + 0.3,
         gx = case_when(lab_side == "right" ~ mx + 1.4, lab_side == "left" ~ mx - 1.4 - gw, lab_side == "below_r" ~ mx - 2.5, lab_side == "above_l" ~ mx - gw - 0.5, TRUE ~ mx - gw / 2),
         gy = case_when(lab_side == "above" ~ my + 2.2 + (nj - j) * 2.9,
                        lab_side == "above_l" ~ my + 2.4,
                        lab_side %in% c("below", "below_r") ~ my - 2.2 - (j - 1) * 2.9,
                        TRUE ~ my + ((nj + 1) / 2 - j) * 2.9))
enz_t <- enz |> crossing(ph = PH) |> mutate(i = match(ph, PH), tx = gx + cw(enz, EPT) + 0.8 + TW / 2 + (i - 1) * (TW + 0.3)) |>
  left_join(gene, by = c(enz = "sym", "ph"))
liv_vals <- MET |> rowwise() |> mutate(d = list(met_val(key, "liver"))) |> ungroup() |> unnest(d)
ser_nodes <- bind_rows(MET |> filter(exp) |> transmute(lab, skey, y), SER_ONLY) |> mutate(x = X_SER)
ser_vals <- ser_nodes |> rowwise() |> mutate(d = list(met_val(skey, "serum"))) |> ungroup() |> unnest(d)
disc <- pair |> filter(disc) |> group_by(key) |> summarise(which = paste(substr(ph, 1, 1), collapse = ","), .groups = "drop")
ser_nodes <- ser_nodes |> left_join(disc, by = c(skey = "key")) |> mutate(in_pair = skey %in% pair$key)
halves <- function(vals) bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(vals)), \(i) {
  r <- vals[i, ]; half(r$x, r$y, R, ifelse(r$ph == PH[1], "L", "R")) |>
    mutate(g = paste(r$lab, r$ph, r$x), v = r$v, sig = !is.na(r$f) & r$f <= MET_FDR)
}))
liv_h <- halves(liv_vals); ser_h <- halves(ser_vals)
tr <- TRP |> mutate(gw = cw(gene, EPT) + 0.8 + 2 * TW + 0.3, gx = x - gw / 2)
tr_t <- tr |> crossing(ph = PH) |> mutate(i = match(ph, PH), tx = gx + cw(gene, EPT) + 0.8 + TW / 2 + (i - 1) * (TW + 0.3)) |>
  left_join(gene, by = c(gene = "sym", "ph"))
## decorations
drops <- tibble(x = c(9, 21, 13, 22.5, 7.5, 18.5, 23, 10), y = c(85, 83, 64, 64, 74, 56, 75, 54),
                r = c(3.2, 2.6, 2.4, 2.0, 1.9, 2.2, 1.6, 1.7))

rbc   <- tibble(x = c(171.5, 168, 172, 168.5, 171.5, 168, 172.5, 167.5, 171, 169), y = c(150, 124, 108, 83, 68, 59, 33, 22, 12, 138),

fenes <- tibble(y0 = seq(14, 148, by = 9)) |> mutate(y1 = y0 + 5.5)            # fenestrated endothelium dashes
b_liv <- filter(prs, outcome == "TG_liver", pPRS == "pprs_disc")
b_ser <- filter(prs, outcome == "TG_serum", pPRS == "pprs_disc")
sup <- function(n) chartr("-0123456789", "⁻⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹", as.character(n))
fmt_p <- function(p) { e <- floor(log10(p)); if (p >= 0.001) sprintf("P = %.3f", p) else sprintf("P = %.1f × 10%s", p / 10^e, sup(e)) }
fmt_b <- function(b) sub("-", "−", sprintf("%+.2f", b))
nuc <- c(x = 16, y = 124, rx = 12.5, ry = 15)
y_stg <- 18
## serum-TG arrow path: from the nucleus down the inside of the cell wall
bp <- rbind(c(7.6, 111.5), c(5.4, 95), c(5.6, 60), c(6.5, 30), c(9.5, 21), c(16, y_stg))
tt <- seq_len(nrow(bp)); ts <- seq(1, nrow(bp), length.out = 200)
blue_path <- tibble(x = spline(tt, bp[, 1], xout = ts, method = "natural")$y,
                    y = spline(tt, bp[, 2], xout = ts, method = "natural")$y)
## =============================================================================
## 4. DRAW
## =============================================================================
pt <- ggplot2::.pt
C_UP <- "#B2182B"; C_DN <- "#2166AC"
C_CELL <- "#F9E9E1"; C_MEMB <- "#A0523A"
fill_sc <- scale_fill_gradient2(low = C_DN, mid = "#F7F7F7", high = C_UP, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-CAP, CAP),
                                oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey85", guide = "none")
arr  <- arrow(length = unit(0.9, "mm"), type = "closed")
arr2 <- arrow(length = unit(1.3, "mm"), type = "closed")
T <- function(x, y, label, size = 6, ...) annotate("text", x = x, y = y, label = label, size = size * TS / pt, family = FONT, ...)
YMIN <- -21; YMAX <- H + YMIN
p <- ggplot() + coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, W), ylim = c(YMIN, YMAX), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_family = FONT) + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
## organ icon + zoom
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = liver_icon, aes(x, y), fill = "#C8735A", colour = "#7E3420", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_path(data = lig, aes(x, y), colour = "#7E3420", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_polygon(data = gb_icon, aes(x, y), fill = "#9DB36A", colour = "#5C6E2A", linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = zoom[["x0"]], xmax = zoom[["x1"]], ymin = zoom[["y0"]], ymax = zoom[["y1"]],
           fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  annotate("segment", x = zoom[["x0"]], y = zoom[["y0"]], xend = CELL[["x0"]] + 1, yend = CELL[["y1"]],
           colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "22") +
  annotate("segment", x = zoom[["x1"]], y = zoom[["y0"]], xend = 60, yend = CELL[["y1"]],
           colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "22") +
  T(43, 168, "Liver", 8, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#6B2A18") +
  T(43, 163.5, "biopsy: transcriptome, lipidome, polar metabolome", 5.4, hjust = 0, colour = "#6B2A18") +
  T(mean(X_VES), 168, "Blood", 8, fontface = "bold", colour = "#8E2F36") +
  T(mean(X_VES), 163.5, "serum polar metabolome", 5.4, colour = "#8E2F36")
## sinusoid
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = rrect(X_VES[1], X_VES[2], 4, 156, r = 14, n = 20), aes(x, y), fill = "#F4CFCB", colour = "#B5424A", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_polygon(data = rrect(X_VES[1] + 2.2, X_VES[2] - 2.2, 6.2, 153.8, r = 12, n = 20), aes(x, y), fill = "#FBEAE8", colour = NA) +
  geom_polygon(data = bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(rbc)), \(k) ell(rbc$x[k], rbc$y[k], rbc$a[k], 2.6, 1.45) |> mutate(g = k))),
               aes(x, y, group = g), fill = "#E39A98", colour = "#C9686A", linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.85) +
  T(mean(X_VES), 152.2, "Sinusoid", 5.6, fontface = "italic", colour = "#8E2F36") +
  annotate("segment", x = mean(X_VES), xend = mean(X_VES), y = 2, yend = -3.6, colour = "#B5424A", linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arr2) +
  T(mean(X_VES), -6.2, "to systemic circulation", 5, colour = "#8E2F36")
## space of Disse + fenestrated endothelium
p <- p +
  annotate("segment", x = 133, xend = 133, y = fenes$y0, yend = fenes$y1, colour = "#B5424A", linewidth = 0.45) +
  T(135.6, 112, "fenestrated endothelium", 4.6, angle = 90, colour = "#8E2F36")
## hepatocyte
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = rrect(CELL[["x0"]], CELL[["x1"]], CELL[["y0"]], CELL[["y1"]], r = 7, n = 14), aes(x, y),
               fill = C_CELL, colour = C_MEMB, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_polygon(data = rrect(CELL[["x0"]] + 0.9, CELL[["x1"]] - 0.9, CELL[["y0"]] + 0.9, CELL[["y1"]] - 0.9, r = 6.2, n = 14),
               aes(x, y), fill = NA, colour = "#D79E89", linewidth = 0.3) +
  T(CELL[["x1"]] - 1.5, CELL[["y1"]] + 1.8, "Sinusoidal (basolateral) membrane", 5, hjust = 1, colour = C_MEMB) +
  T(9, CELL[["y1"]] + 2.2, "Hepatocyte", 6.5, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#6B2A18")
## nucleus with the genetic instrument
helix <- tibble(t = seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 120)) |>
  mutate(x1 = nuc[["x"]] + 2.2 * sin(t), x2 = nuc[["x"]] - 2.2 * sin(t), y = nuc[["y"]] - 2 + t / (4 * pi) * 11)
rungs <- helix[seq(5, 120, by = 8), ]
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = ell(nuc[["x"]], nuc[["y"]], 0, nuc[["rx"]], nuc[["ry"]]), aes(x, y), fill = "#E6DDF2", colour = "#6A58A0", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_segment(data = rungs, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), colour = "#B7AAD9", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_path(data = helix, aes(x1, y), colour = "#4B3A8A", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_path(data = helix, aes(x2, y), colour = "#8E7FC4", linewidth = 0.5) +
  T(nuc[["x"]], nuc[["y"]] - 5.2, "Discordant\npPRS", 5.6, fontface = "bold", colour = "#3E3266", lineheight = 0.9) +
  T(nuc[["x"]], nuc[["y"]] - 10.6, "genetic hepatic\nlipid retention", 4.7, colour = "#3E3266", lineheight = 0.9)
## lipid droplets, mitochondria
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(drops)), \(k) circ(drops$x[k], drops$y[k], drops$r[k]) |> mutate(g = k))),
               aes(x, y, group = g), fill = "#F5DC86", colour = "#C8A43C", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_polygon(data = bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(mito)), \(k) ell(mito$x[k], mito$y[k], mito$a[k], 3.6, 1.6) |> mutate(g = k))),
               aes(x, y, group = g), fill = "#F2C9B4", colour = "#B9765C", linewidth = 0.25) +
  T(17, 49.2, "lipid droplets", 4.8, colour = "#7A5A12") + T(16, 35, "mitochondria", 4.8, colour = "#8A4A32")
## cards
for (i in seq_len(nrow(CARD))) {
  cd <- CARD[i, ]
  p <- p + geom_polygon(data = rrect(cd$x0, cd$x1, cd$y0, cd$y1, r = 2.2), aes(x, y), fill = "white", alpha = 0.92,
                        colour = "#D9A893", linewidth = 0.25) +
    T(cd$x0 + 1.8, cd$y1 - 2.3, cd$title, 6.2, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey15")
}
## pathways
p <- p +
  geom_segment(data = arrows, aes(x = xs, y = ys, xend = xe, yend = ye), linetype = arrows$lty,
               linewidth = 0.28, colour = "grey25", arrow = arr) +
  geom_text(data = TXT, aes(x, y, label = lab), family = FONT, size = 5.8 * TS / pt, lineheight = 0.88, colour = "grey10") +
  geom_text(data = enz, aes(gx, gy, label = enz), family = FONT, fontface = "italic", size = EPT * TS / pt, hjust = 0) +
  geom_tile(data = enz_t, aes(tx, gy, fill = v), width = TW, height = TH, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12)
## TDCA is a secondary bile acid (deoxycholate formed by gut bacteria, re-conjugated in the liver)
a_tdca <- filter(arrows, to == "tdca")
p <- p + T(a_tdca$mx - 3, a_tdca$my - 3.6, "via gut\nmicrobial DCA", 4.8, fontface = "italic", colour = "grey30", lineheight = 0.9)
## bile export: conjugates -> canalicular membrane (ABCB11) -> bile canaliculus
p <- p +
  annotate("segment", x = 104, xend = 104, y = 37.5, yend = CELL[["y0"]] + 2.6, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.28, arrow = arr) +
  annotate("segment", x = 104, xend = 104, y = CELL[["y0"]] - 2.4, yend = 4.2, colour = "#5C6E2A", linewidth = 0.4, arrow = arr) +
  geom_polygon(data = rrect(70, 124, -1, 3.6, r = 2.3), aes(x, y), fill = "#DDE6BE", colour = "#5C6E2A", linewidth = 0.35) +
  T(97, 1.3, "Bile canaliculus → bile, gallbladder", 5.2, colour = "#3F4D1A") +
  T(70, CELL[["y0"]] + 1.7, "canalicular membrane", 4.8, hjust = 0, colour = C_MEMB)
## exchange: liver node -> transporter -> serum node
ex <- ser_nodes |> left_join(MET |> select(lab, lx = x), by = "lab")
p <- p + geom_segment(data = filter(ex, !is.na(lx)), aes(x = lx + R + 1.2, xend = X_SER - R - 1.2, y = y, yend = y),
                      colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "22")
## transporters
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(tr)), \(k) rrect(tr$gx[k] - 0.9, tr$gx[k] + tr$gw[k] + 0.7,
                                                                     tr$y[k] - 1.9, tr$y[k] + 1.9, r = 1.9) |> mutate(g = k))),
               aes(x, y, group = g), fill = "#F6E7DA", colour = C_MEMB, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = tr, aes(gx, y, label = gene), family = FONT, fontface = "italic", size = EPT * TS / pt, hjust = 0) +
  geom_tile(data = tr_t, aes(tx, y, fill = v), width = TW, height = TH, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.12)
## metabolite circles
p <- p +
  geom_polygon(data = liv_h, aes(x, y, group = g, fill = v), colour = NA) +
  geom_polygon(data = ser_h, aes(x, y, group = g, fill = v), colour = NA) +
  geom_polygon(data = filter(bind_rows(liv_h, ser_h), !sig), aes(x, y, group = g), fill = NA, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_polygon(data = filter(bind_rows(liv_h, ser_h), sig), aes(x, y, group = g), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.38) +
  geom_text(data = MET, aes(x - R - 0.8, y, label = lab), family = FONT, size = 5.8 * TS / pt, hjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = ser_nodes, aes(X_SER + R + 1, y, label = lab), family = FONT, size = 5.8 * TS / pt, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = filter(ser_nodes, !is.na(which)), aes(X_SER + R + 2 + cw(lab, 5.8), y, label = paste0("Δ", which)),
            family = FONT, size = 5.4 * TS / pt, hjust = 0) +
  geom_text(data = filter(ser_nodes, !in_pair), aes(X_SER + R + 1, y, label = paste0(lab, " †")),
            family = FONT, size = 5.8 * TS / pt, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "black")
## genetics: nucleus -> hepatic TG (up), nucleus -> serum TG (down)
p <- p +
  annotate("curve", x = nuc[["x"]] - 3, y = nuc[["y"]] - nuc[["ry"]] - 0.5, xend = 15, yend = 73 + R + 0.8,
           curvature = 0.2, colour = C_UP, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arr2) +
  T(30.5, 99, sprintf("↑ hepatic TG\nβ = %s SD\n%s", fmt_b(b_liv$beta), fmt_p(b_liv$p)), 5, colour = C_UP,
    lineheight = 0.92, hjust = 1) +
  geom_path(data = blue_path, aes(x, y), colour = C_DN, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("segment", x = 16, xend = X_SER - R - 1, y = y_stg, yend = y_stg, colour = C_DN, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arr2) +
  T(66, y_stg + 2.4, sprintf("↓ serum TG   β = %s SD, %s", fmt_b(b_ser$beta), fmt_p(b_ser$p)), 5.2, colour = C_DN) +
  annotate("point", x = X_SER, y = y_stg, shape = 21, size = 2 * R * 1.27, fill = "#DCE6F2", colour = C_DN, stroke = 0.5) +
  T(X_SER + R + 1, y_stg + 0.4, "TG", 5.8, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
  T(X_SER + R + 1, y_stg - 3, "clinical", 4.8, hjust = 0, colour = "grey30")
## legend
lx <- 4; ly <- -10.5
grad <- tibble(v = seq(-CAP, CAP, length.out = 31), x = lx + seq(0, 24, length.out = 31))
leg_half <- bind_rows(half(lx + 41, ly, 2.4, "L") |> mutate(g = "a", v = 0.45), half(lx + 41, ly, 2.4, "R") |> mutate(g = "b", v = -0.45))
leg_tile <- tibble(x = c(lx + 69, lx + 72.2), y = ly, v = c(0.35, -0.35))
p <- p +
  geom_tile(data = grad, aes(x, ly + 0.8, fill = v), width = 0.82, height = 2.2) +
  T(lx, ly - 2.1, sprintf("≤−%.1f", CAP), 5, hjust = 0.3) + T(lx + 12, ly - 2.1, "0", 5) +
  T(lx + 24, ly - 2.1, sprintf("≥%.1f", CAP), 5, hjust = 0.7) +
  T(lx + 12, ly + 4, "Effect, grade ≥1 vs 0", 5.4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_polygon(data = leg_half, aes(x, y, group = g, fill = v), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  T(lx + 37.6, ly + 3.6, "S", 5.4, fontface = "bold") + T(lx + 44.4, ly + 3.6, "I", 5.4, fontface = "bold") +
  T(lx + 45.4, ly - 0.2, "metabolite\nblack rim, FDR ≤ 0.10", 4.9, hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_tile(data = leg_tile, aes(x, y, fill = v), width = TW, height = TH, colour = "white") +
  T(lx + 67.7, ly + 3.4, "S   I", 5.4, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
  T(lx + 75, ly, "enzyme /\ntransporter", 4.9, hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.9) +
  T(lx + 89, ly + 2.4, "ΔS,I  liver–serum discordant (paired model, FDR ≤ 0.10)", 5, hjust = 0) +
  T(lx + 89, ly - 0.7, "†  not in the matched panel (separate liver and serum analyses)", 5, hjust = 0) +
  T(lx + 89, ly - 3.8, "S, steatosis; I, lobular inflammation; grey, not significant / not DE", 5, hjust = 0, colour = "grey25") +
  fill_sc
## =============================================================================
## 5. SAVE (vector + high-resolution raster) AND VALUE TABLE
## =============================================================================
f <- function(ext) file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(STEM, ext))
ggsave(f(".pdf"), p, width = W, height = H, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(f(".png"), p, width = W, height = H, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(f(".tiff"), p, width = W, height = H, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
```
